A company's Formation documents serve as the proof of existence of your company. It verifies the company's type (LLC or Branch) as well as its date of incorporation.
A share register lists all of the people who own shares in your company and the number of shares allocated to individual shareholders.
A Lease Agreement serves as proof of address for the company.

A Memorandum of Association (MOA) is a legal document prepared during the formation and registration of a limited liability company - they define the company's relationship with shareholders. The MOA is accessible to the public and describes the company's name, the physical address of the registered office, names of shareholders and the distribution of shares. The MOA and the Articles of Association serve as the constitution of the company.
